assessment.control_definition: The exact scored v26 CSV is frozen for official-test inference. Fresh-fold F1 uses a matched v26 recipe refit because exact v26 fold checkpoints were not exported. Every survey assessed by v21 through v26 is excluded from v27 assessment.

rarity_groups.note: Rarity is fold-specific; pooled counts are sums of fold metrics.

assessment.warning: Matched-recipe spatial cross-fit evidence, not a hidden-test score.

frozen_v26_baseline.storage: lossless counts:uint8 plus species-column:uint16, LZMA compressed

hash_note: A file cannot contain its own byte hash; the manifest records the report hash, and the notebook prints the manifest hash after finalization.

oracle_count.target: per-survey oracle top-k maximizing sample F1 on selection only

training.augmentation: Sentinel random horizontal/vertical flips and quarter rotations
